keengamer.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

howto.name: HowToVideoGame — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — it is the last trophy by definition. Plan around the two long poles: A Long Road (100% completion, the Gold) and the one possibly missable meditation in Chapter 1 for Positive Mental Attitude. Everything else can be cleaned up in free roam after the story, so there is no rush once those two are safe.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish the opening mission Gone Fishing, Jason's first mission. It unlocks through normal play and cannot be missed; just play the mission to its end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish Chapter 1. It pops automatically at the end of the chapter. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy): it is the only possibly missable step in the whole game.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish Chapter 2. Automatic at the chapter's end. Once both Jason and Lucia are playable together, the wider map of side content opens up, including the activities and collectibles for later stages.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish Chapter 3. Automatic at the chapter's end. The robbery trophies start opening up around Chapters 3 and 4, so keep an eye out for bank vaults and armored trucks from here on.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish Chapter 4. Automatic at the chapter's end. You are one chapter from the finale; make a manual save at the start of the final chapter, since the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy — finish the final mission. Automatic when the credits roll. After the story, free roam continues, so do the 100% checklist and the cleanup trophies then; nothing on the checklist is missable.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the mission Breakfast Run. Automatic when the mission ends; play it through as part of the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Automatic when the mission ends. Heist missions like this one teach the robbery mechanics you will reuse for the standalone robbery trophies in Stage 2.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the mission Child's Play. Automatic when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the mission Headliners. Automatic when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Automatic when the mission ends. The airport is also the setting for the Catch Me If You Can trophy, so note the layout while you are here.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy — complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Automatic when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist appears after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but everything you did before already counts, and nothing on it is missable. Per PowerPyx it is roughly 60% of true completion: scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, collect 50 of 66 weapons, finish 70 of 80 challenges, plus the robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vault robberies), shooting ranges, drone races, Bret's Target Decks, underwater discoveries and 15 of 18 meditation spots. Budget around 100 hours for this step alone — it is the longest grind on the road to platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps and trick driving around Leonida all count toward the 250, so work on them in free roam after the story — fast cars, ramps and stunt jumps, repeated. Your progress is tracked in the Progress menu, and stunts also feed the challenges that A Long Road wants.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The activities are the game's side activities — races, fishing, the arcade, bowling, the shooting range, drone races and the rest. You only need to dip into each type once; you do not need to win or master any of them, so sample one of each as they unlock during the story.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Find the ranges around Leonida, learn each challenge's target pattern, and replay until you hit gold. The ranges are part of the 100% checklist too, so this folds into Stage 2 — do not leave it as a separate chore.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every drone-race location. Learn each course's gates, cut corners where the course allows, and win once per location. Drone races are also on the 100% checklist, so tick them off during Stage 2.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different race events count separately, so enter a spread of race events across the map instead of repeating one track twenty times. Races count toward the 100% checklist as well.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, fish it properly, and out-score him. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so you will already have tried it for Master of None — this one just asks you to win against Cal.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into any arcade, pick a cabinet, and play one game through to its end. Any arcade game counts, so choose the shortest one you can finish.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand appears as a side character's missions; play his missions in order until the strand's final mission. Side-character strands also feed the Strangers & Freaks trophy (8 strands), so work them together in Stage 3.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's mission strand in order until its final mission. Like the other side-character finals, it counts toward the Strangers & Freaks strands in Stage 3.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's mission strand in order until its final mission, as part of the Stage 3 stranger cleanup.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map; finish 8 full strands. The side-character final missions (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) each count as one strand, so play those five plus any three other stranger strands in Stage 3.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's mission strand in order until its final mission, as part of the Stage 3 stranger cleanup.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's mission strand in order until its final mission, as part of the Stage 3 stranger cleanup.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts as +2. THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks out to the balcony — follow her, choose Accept, and do the balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends, because it becomes permanently unavailable afterwards and it is not yet confirmed whether it is required for the trophy. The other spots stay available after the story, and 100% completion only needs 15 of 18. Track spots under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunts target specific rare animals; follow his strand, track the animal he names, and take it down. Studying animals with binoculars (100 needed for the 100% checklist) pairs naturally with this — study first, hunt second.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect full sets of them. The Progress > Collections screen shows which cards you still need, so use it as your checklist while you sweep the map in Stage 2.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app at 100 different spots around the map — it is a check-in at each location, so keep the app open while you explore and tag every new place. Scanning vehicles with WAiNK (200 needed for 100%) overlaps with this, so do both on the same map sweep.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The game tracks 80 challenges in total, and 70 of them count toward 100% completion, so pick the 50 easiest across driving, combat, exploration and activities. Challenges tick over naturally while you work the other trophies — check the Progress menu and finish the cheap ones deliberately.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears. A quiet stretch of countryside or water works better than downtown for shaking the search.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner alongside, keeping the wanted level alive between robberies — plan a route of three nearby shops so you are not driving across the map between hits.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or encounter 100 different vehicles; scanning them with the WAiNK app counts toward the 200 vehicles the 100% checklist wants, so do both together from the start of the story — every new vehicle you meet is progress on two trophies at once.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus in a fight with a group of enemies close together and drop five before the focus ends — a crowded shootout with enemies bunched up is the place to try it, not a one-on-one.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Get to the airport and leave by an unscheduled route — take a plane out without going through the normal departure flow. The exact trigger has not been pinned down in the cited guides yet, so treat the airport visit as the starting point and check PowerPyx or GTABase for the confirmed method.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — the trophy is tied to the Rhino tank. Get into a Rhino tank and put it to use; military areas are the usual place to find one. Drive it around and cause chaos until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — avoid cameras and guards, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so plan the entry and exit before you go in.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies are part of the robbery strand; plan each one, crack the vault, and get clear. Eight vault robberies exist in total per the 100% checklist breakdown, so you need five of them — they also count toward A Long Road.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash, and lose the wanted level. Trucks roam the highways, so watch for them while you travel between other objectives.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named region of the map — the whole state, not just Vice City. The game tracks discovered areas, so mop up the corners you never visited during the story in Stage 2; this pairs with the WAiNK check-ins and vehicle scanning.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Each gang runs illegal operations around Leonida; hit one operation per gang. Learn which operations belong to which gang and work through the list one gang at a time.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view over the water, and order a cocktail. A quick, relaxing trophy to grab whenever you are in Vice City.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's glass front and out the other side — the old-school GTA showroom smash, done in Leonida.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at that alley and finish a game — follow through on your throws and play the game out to the end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The official description gives no concrete step, and the cited guides have not pinned down the exact trigger yet (as of 19 Nov 2026) — it reads as a social-media or partnership milestone, so build your following with your partner as you play and check the cited guides for the confirmed method.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). This pops on a story choice — play through the story and make the choices as they come. A choice is always made, so it cannot be missed in the usual sense, though which choice triggers it has not been confirmed by the cited guides yet.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description points at succeeding on a second attempt — retry something you failed once and get it right the second time. The exact trigger has not been confirmed by the cited guides yet (as of 19 Nov 2026), so keep it in mind whenever a retry comes up.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: 'What the hell just happened?' — the description reads like an easter egg or UFO-style encounter somewhere in Leonida. No confirmed trigger in the cited guides yet (as of 19 Nov 2026); check PowerPyx and GTABase as players crack it, and keep exploring the state's odd corners.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock people down with a melee attack performed from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar weapon, near the bowling alley. Line up a slow pass and swing as you go by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. Robberies in Stage 2 keep the bills flowing, so launder as you go rather than saving it all for the end.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total in shops — vehicles, clothes, weapons and property purchases all count toward the total. It adds up naturally over a full playthrough; if you are short at the end, buy an expensive vehicle.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property on the market — the properties that store your vehicle collection. They are bought with in-game money, so save up during Stage 2 and buy them as they appear.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find 10 vehicles and register each one in the Scooter Bros app. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you drive anyway as you play.
